results.name: Underground Bunker
results.description:
This is a PBRish personal project created excusevly for SketchFab. Main goal was to use real-time rendering and not baked lights and shadows to create most interactive scene. And I actually succeed in that. :-)
So, today I wanna invite you to the top secret bunker of Worldwide Secret Television. It was built during the Cold War by enthusiasts, mostly from TV and mass-media industry.
Of course, it wasn't even designed to withstand atomic blast, but surely do it's primary function of a secret hideaway, from where you tell all the truth of the world and communicate to others.
As you can see, today it's pretty old and dated, even natural tree, in which was injected an antenna, works no more as a disguise, but rather this inserted tech helping it not to fall apart. 
As I mentioned previously, this project was done with and for SketchFab viewer, so I have actual WIP scenes, here is one of them: 
 https://skfb.ly/Y6xA 
I wish I can tell you more about this project, but it seems I've reached character limit here.:-)

results.name: Vault Door
results.description:
Animated vault door based on the installations inside [**Dokumentationsstätte Regierungsbunker**](https://www.regbu.de/) history museum.
Cables, pipes and the piston were animated using an interactive IK setup. This project served me a good practice in rigging and animation. Model has 6 PBR materials at different resolutions (4K, 2K and 1K). Door passage is about 2 meters tall.
Each material is composed of 3 PBR maps, whereas normals use the [**OpenGL format**](https://help.poliigon.com/en/articles/4534195-normal-map-formats/).
Original ZIP contains two extra [**FLAC**](https://xiph.org/flac/) sounds for this animation. Modelling and animation were done in [**Blender 2.92**](http://blender.org) and [**Substance Painter 2019**](https://www.adobe.com/products/substance3d-painter.html) did the texturing.
[**Audacity 2.3.3**](https://www.audacityteam.org/) was used for audio design.

results.name: 'Stekelvarken S3' Kazemat (Dutch WWII bunker)
results.description:
3D model of a Dutch bunker type S3 'stekelvarken' ('porcupine'). This bunker type was designed in 1939 and housed one light machine gun. The gun could be positioned in one of the three hatches, and the other two could be locked off with a 2cm thick steel door. The bunker's walls were made of 80cm thick reinforced concrete. A total of 763 bunkers of this type have been built in the days before WWII in the Netherlands. During the invasion by the German army in may 1940 the S3 bunkers proved to be vulnerable because of their relatively thin walls and big shooting holes. Source: http://www.grebbelinie.nl/page/s3

Created in Blender
